scope: Qualification sensitivity only; physical interventions, verifiers, and complete-input certificates are unaffected.
discovery: An independent native recount reproduced the MuJoCo qualification verdict but found some unequal contrasts. The maximum-distance patch center tied at adjacent pixels.
status: MuJoCo calibration outcomes seen. Isaac calibration is rendering. No fresh verifier outcomes have been read.
original_rule: Break ties by distance to the reference-box center, then row and column. The pre-scene protocol pins no array-index origin convention.

implementations.numeric-midpoint: The measurement implementation used (left+right)/2 for an integer-indexed candidate and the analogous y value. The evaluator adopted this before reading any calibration outcome.
implementations.pixel-centers: The independent reconstruction used (left+right-1)/2 for pixel centers inside a half-open box and the analogous y value.

decision: Preserve the original score for numeric-midpoint. Report both conventions for every calibration pair and screen. No convention may qualify a semantic label or alter the verifier experiment.
